{{Attr|Corpse}} (Variable) }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|They're using heat distortion to blur themselves out!|audio=MoltenWave13-2.ogg|[[Professor V]] on Wave 13 ([[Molten Mode|Molten]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Molten Demon''' is an enemy that appears in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] and Molten Arena [[PVP]] modes, and in [[The Takeover Event]]. It spawns in groups starting on Wave 11 of [[Molten Mode|Molten]] as [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemies, but it can also be summoned by the [[Molten Necromancer]]. ==Appereance== The '''Molten Demon''' has a light red skin, with a few light brown flesh appearing on its body, some of it stitched up. It has two horns coming out of its head. ==Strategy== *The '''Molten Demon''' can be a threat when it first appears, as it is quite speedy and comes early, becoming a run-killer to loadouts without early hidden detection. Many can stack with the ones summoned by the [[Molten Necromancer]] in later waves if it is not killed quickly. **They can be killed fairly quickly, so one or two hidden detection towers can take them out. **Towers like the [[Cowboy]], [[Militant]], [[Military Base]] or [[Electroshocker]] can be effective against this. **High DPS towers like the [[Minigunner]] and [[Crook Boss]] can be prepared specifically for this enemy if early game towers are not enough, using the [[Farm]] to get them as they may be quite expensive. **Area of effect towers, like the [[Trapper]], [[Rocketeer]] or [[Electroshocker]] can be quite useful as they can damage all the '''Molten Demons''' as well as the [[Molten Necromancer]] at once, if spawned from it. *The '''Molten Demons''' summoned by the [[Molten Necromancer]] can sometimes spawn with the [[Nimble]] attribute. As such, some towers with high, sustained damage are needed, combined with hidden detection. **If you do not have much hidden detection, you can use the [[UAV]] or a Level 4+ [[Ace Pilot]] to give hidden detection. *Do note that you do not earn any money from the '''Molten Demons''' summoned by [[Molten Necromancer]], but you gain money for killing naturally spawned '''Molten Demons'''. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1MoltenDemon.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker2MoltenDemon.png|Overclock variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseMoltenDemon1.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, original animation variant (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} V2.1.0GenericThumbnail8.png|'''Molten Demon''' on the game thumbnail. V2.1.0GenericThumbnail10.png|'''Molten Demon''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Enforcer Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Molten Demon''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} MoltenDemonIconIG.png|'''Molten Demon''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Update History== *'''11 December 2024''' - [[v1.45.0]] **'''Molten Demon''' added. *'''9 April 2025''' - [[v1.60.0]] **Now appears in Mid Rank [[PVP Test]]. *'''23 April 2025''' - [[v1.62.0]] **No longer appears in the [[PVP Test]] as it has been removed. *'''23 July 2025''' - [[v1.71.0]] **Now appears in Molten Arena [[PVP]], carrying over all of its [[PVP Test]] statistics. *'''12 September 2025''' - [[v1.74.0|v1.74.3a]] **Now appears in [[Sk8 P4rk]] Master difficulty as part of [[The Takeover Event]]. ***Has 70 health in [[Sk8 P4rk]]. *'''22 September 2025''' - [[v1.74.0|v1.74.3g]] **No longer appears in [[Sk8 P4rk]], as it has been removed. *'''28 January 2026''' - [[v1.84.0]] **Now naturally appears in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode on Wave 11. **Health increased from 70 to 160. **Speed increased from Above Average (4) to Slightly Fast (5.25). **Now gives {{Money|175}} on death. **Now is a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy. {{Molten|[[Molten]]|Wave 9|Molten Demon|Wave 11|[[Breaker3]]|Wave 14}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Early-Game]] [[Category:Molten Arena PVP]] [[Category:The Takeover Event]]
